answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short. A ocean of per-task receipts records who did what, and the river of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
